title: Playboy Magazine June 1970 Playmate of the Year Claudia Jennings PMOY Issue
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning and soiling, edge wear along the left side, and creasing and small chips at the corners, most visible at the upper left. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1970 issue. Cover price one dollar.

This is the Playmate of the Year issue. The 1970 title went to Claudia Jennings, Miss November 1969, who left Playboy for a film career and became one of the best known B-movie leads of the 1970s before her death in 1979. Her Playmate of the Year issue is one of the more sought after of the era.

The cover is the rabbit-head-and-magenta design with the single "Playmate of the Year" cover line.

The back cover carries a 1970 Mercury Capri ad from Lincoln-Mercury - "the first sexy European under $2300."

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
